arms: A = frozen validate(); B = mirror caller with the registered material-supplies question only (Ast-I text, unchanged); no other prompt/pipeline difference
derived_from: Ast-I SAFE_IMPROVEMENT (single-item E2 fix) + open generalization question; E2 itself is spent as acceptance item and EXCLUDED from holdout arms
diagnostic_status: DESIGN ONLY - no sentences built, no validator executed, no pipeline touched
gold_leakage_rules: frozen operational definition reused unchanged; all gold fixed BEFORE any run; fresh sentences/entities with exact-text-match audit vs all corpora and all probe files (incl. E2/H5/F1/F2/C1/C2 verbatim texts); reused sentinel items verbatim (stability comparison requires identity)
holdout_construction_exact: 6 fresh TRUE supply-transfer items (canonical SVO supply/provide/deliver frames with explicitly MATERIAL transfer objects only; donate allowed solely for explicit material provision/handover, never for support/aid in general; no E2 word or sentence-template reuse) + 2 fresh H5-analog help-frame TRUE items (bearings/aid-type help, fresh entities) + 4 reused safety sentinels verbatim (F1/F2 FALSE, C1/C2 TRUE-ACCEPT). Total 12 items x 2 arms = 24 requests.
objective: test whether the accepted H-SUPPLY fix generalizes beyond the single E2 item to fresh supply-transfer cases, with safety sentinels fencing every arm

preregistered_numeric_verdicts.DISQUALIFIED: any sentinel flips vs its frozen verdict (F->ACCEPT, anchor->SILENCE), or ANY H5-analog flips under B (per Ast H: uncontrolled widening of the semantic decision boundary), or provenance/trail/technical violations (Ast H gates apply unchanged)
preregistered_numeric_verdicts.GENERALIZATION_CONFIRMED: B accepts >=5/6 fresh-supply AND sentinels all stable AND A rejects >=5/6 fresh-supply (gap reproduced in A)
preregistered_numeric_verdicts.NO_GENERALIZATION: B accepts <=2/6 fresh-supply (fix does not transfer; E2 stays a single-item effect)
preregistered_numeric_verdicts.PARTIAL: B accepts 3-4/6 fresh-supply with sentinels stable: report, no claim
preregistered_numeric_verdicts.PROBE_INVALID: A accepts >=2/6 fresh-supply (no gap to fix in this sample) or validity failures

safety_sentinels: F1/F2 must stay rejected, C1/C2 must stay accepted under BOTH arms; H5-analogs expected unchanged vs A (any flip = general-loosening evidence per Ast-D lesson, not success)
status: DESIGN FROZEN FOR REVIEW - build and run require separate approvals
trail_fields: same P1/P2 trail as V-probe plus prompt_version per arm; raw responses mandatory
